title: Email news
description: New tournaments, results and community updates from AFC, by email. You can stop at any time, here or from any of these emails.
off: Off. AFC sends you only the emails your account needs, like sign-in codes and receipts.
on: On. You will get AFC news by email.
neverShared: Your email address is never shared or sold.
saveFailed: That did not save. Please try again.
promptBody: New tournaments, results and community updates. You can change your mind any time in Account and security.
promptThanks: Saved. You can change it any time in Account and security.
unBody: AFC will stop sending news to {email}.
unKeep: Emails your account needs, like sign-in codes and receipts, still arrive.
unDoneBody: You will not get AFC news by email any more. Changed your mind?
unInvalidBody: Sign in and change email news in Account and security.
unErrorBody: Please open the link from the email again in a minute.
